description: Workout timer whose interval effect calls setElapsedSeconds(elapsedSeconds + 1) with only [isRunning] as dependencies, so the callback captures a stale elapsedSeconds and the display sticks at 1; cleanup, the completion effect and useMemo dependencies are correct

hard.note: The effect has a dependency array and a cleanup; the only defect is the captured elapsedSeconds instead of a functional updater

_calibration.note: Window modeled on the framework's existing *-reactivity-issues fixture (one error per planted defect), narrowed to the single planted defect plus room for one incidental warning or suggestion.
